reason: I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not handing my CRM, my emails and my customers to an unknown company for 99 € a month, and 59 € only if I lock in a full year. I might poke at the free plan, but 50 credits total tells me nothing about whether it actually saves me time.
objection: Will this company still exist in two years, and if it disappears what happens to my customer data and all the setup I did? Also, I have no idea what a 'credit' is or how fast 100 of them run out.
would_change_my_mind: A monthly plan I can cancel anytime at around 39-49 €, with a clear explanation of what a credit buys, plus a reference from a small business near me showing hours actually saved.
